subject.title: Telegram should default to allowlist mode with owner ID

question: Which authenticated first-owner flow and upgrade boundary should Telegram use before automatically persisting owner-only allowlist configuration?
rationale: The implementation must choose both a race-resistant proof of owner intent and whether existing omitted-policy installations retain pairing; source behavior cannot determine those security and compatibility policies.

options.title: Verified fresh onboarding
options.body: Generate a one-time token, capture only the Telegram sender who returns it, and write explicit owner allowlists for new setup while leaving existing installations unchanged.

options.title: Verified post-pairing transition
options.body: Keep pairing for initial bootstrap, then persist the first explicitly approved account as owner and stop future pairing challenges unless pairing was explicitly configured.

options.title: Global default migration
options.body: Change omitted `dmPolicy` to allowlist for all installations and provide a doctor migration and recovery path for configurations without a resolvable owner.

recommendation.title: Verified fresh onboarding
recommendation.body: Generate a one-time token, capture only the Telegram sender who returns it, and write explicit owner allowlists for new setup while leaving existing installations unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history spans the Telegram runtime, setup, documentation, and onboarding surfaces needed for this cross-boundary decision.
